description: Processes customer billing disputes for telecom services, validates eligibility, calculates adjustments based on dispute type and customer tier, and routes to appropriate resolution workflow.

rules.description: Validate all required dispute input fields: dispute_id, account_id, dispute_type, dispute_amount
rules.effect: REJECT with D001 if dispute_id is blank; REJECT with D002 if account_id is blank; REJECT with D003 if dispute_type not in ('OVCHG','SVCFL','LATFE','TAXER'); REJECT with D004 if dispute_amount <= 0; REJECT with D005 if dispute_amount > invoice_total

rules.description: Dispute must be filed within 90 days of invoice date
Maximum 12 disputes per year per account
rules.effect: REJECT with D007 if prior_disputes_ytd >= 12 and customer_tier != 'PLATINUM'

rules.description: Adjustment calculation based on dispute type: OVCHG=100%, LATFE=50%, TAXER=110%, SVCFL=75% (no SLA) or 100% (with SLA)
rules.effect: IF dispute_type='SVCFL' AND sla_violation_flag=true THEN adjustment=dispute_amount AND type='FULL-CREDIT'; IF dispute_type='OVCHG' THEN adjustment=dispute_amount AND type='FULL-CREDIT'; IF dispute_type='LATFE' THEN adjustment=dispute_amount*0.50 AND type='PARTIAL-CRD'; IF dispute_type='TAXER' THEN adjustment=dispute_amount*1.10 AND type='FULL+GDWILL'; IF dispute_type='SVCFL' AND sla_violation_flag=false THEN adjustment=dispute_amount*0.75 AND type='PARTIAL-CRD'

rules.description: SLA violation with service failure gets automatic full credit
rules.effect: IF dispute_type='SVCFL' AND sla_violation_flag=true THEN adjustment=dispute_amount AND type='FULL-CREDIT'

rules.description: Loyalty bonus: customers with >24 months tenure get 15% extra on partial credits
rules.effect: IF months_as_customer > 24 AND adjustment_type not in ('FULL-CREDIT','FULL+GDWILL') THEN adjustment = adjustment * 1.15
rules.implicit_reason: Loyalty multiplier is applied after the base calculation and only to partial credits, hidden in a nested conditional

rules.description: Approval level: AUTO (<=500), SUPERVISOR (<=1000), MANAGER (>1000 with escalation)
rules.effect: IF adjustment_amount <= 500 THEN approval='AUTO'; IF 500 < adjustment_amount <= 1000 THEN approval='SUPERVISOR'; IF adjustment_amount > 1000 THEN approval='MANAGER' AND escalation=true

rules.description: Platinum customers get auto-approval for disputes up to $1000
rules.effect: IF customer_tier='PLATINUM' AND adjustment_amount <= 1000 THEN approval='AUTO'
rules.implicit_reason: Platinum auto-approval override is applied after the standard routing logic, overriding SUPERVISOR to AUTO

rules.description: Auto-approved disputes apply credit immediately to account balance
rules.effect: IF approval='AUTO' THEN account_balance = account_balance - adjustment_amount AND credit_applied=true

rules.description: Non-auto-approved disputes set to PENDING status
rules.effect: IF approval != 'AUTO' THEN credit_applied=false AND resolution_code='PENDING'

rules.description: Platinum customers exempt from yearly dispute frequency limit
rules.effect: IF customer_tier='PLATINUM' THEN skip dispute frequency check (BR-003 does not apply)
rules.implicit_reason: The Platinum exemption is nested inside the frequency check conditional, not stated as a separate rule

rules.description: Account balance never goes below zero after credit (negative balance protection)
rules.implicit_reason: Balance floor is applied silently after credit, without raising an error

constraints.constraint: Must be one of: OVCHG, SVCFL, LATFE, TAXER
Must be one of: PLATINUM, GOLD, SILVER, BRONZE

test_scenarios.description: Late fee dispute with loyalty bonus
